seasonRows.notes: District 7. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 383 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.21106, -127.08937, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 7.6 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 183 m, about 170 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 150 m S of the spot at 1,235 m (57.21419, -127.2142). Water: unnamed lake 90 m W (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-39, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2018-11-21, closures 2026-10-16.
